label: python_off-Minja -> python_on-Jinja
purpose: #1497: OVMS docs state 'using tools is not supported in configuration without Python', and 2026.3 release notes name Qwen3-Coder as a template MINJA cannot render. This measures what actually changed on the swap.

before.template_engine: Minja (forced: 'the only option for builds without Python')

measurement.methodology: identical multi-turn chat/completions request replayed against each build: user -> assistant(tool_calls) -> tool result -> user. temperature 0, max_tokens 300, tools=[write_file]. Direct to OVMS :8000, no proxy.
measurement.interpretation: 59 fewer tokens for byte-identical history is consistent with Minja dumping the prior tool_calls turn into the prompt as raw JSON while Jinja renders it in the model's native syntax.

prefill_throughput_tok_s.note: measured on the py_off build; ~275 tok/s steady, cold first request ~33s

not_measured: whether the corrupted Minja history actually changed CODER BEHAVIOUR end to end - only the prompt encoding and the warning were measured
prefill throughput was NOT re-measured on the python_on build
no multi-turn conversation deeper than 2 assistant turns was exercised
single sample per figure; no variance
